title: הגז שלא קיים עד שחותכים את הבצל
summary: Why onions make you cry: no tear gas in a whole onion — sulphur precursors (cytoplasm) and alliinase (vacuole) meet only when cells are cut; Imai et al. (Nature 2002) found the second enzyme, lachrymatory-factor synthase (absent in garlic; Ig Nobel 2013); gas peaks ~30 s; cold, sharp knife and water reduce tears; the 2015 House Foods low-tear onion has reduced alliinase (Kato 2016); maths: cube surface area grows ×k when each edge is cut into k, and the rough ×2-per-10 °C rule.
